files.prompt_en:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: transparent full-body character portrait for a Japanese fantasy adventure game
Scene/backdrop: fully transparent background, isolated figure only
Style/medium: finely drawn ink outlines, soft layered watercolor and opaque painted shading, restrained storybook fantasy illustration, warm natural skin tones and nuanced fabric folds
Primary request: an anonymous water and equipment inspector, standing attentively with empty hands, one hand making a small open explanatory gesture and the other relaxed near the waist.
Subject: a middle-aged adult with short dark chestnut hair swept back and a composed observant face, a muted slate blue long-sleeved knee-length working coat over a cream high-neck shirt, a simple pale grey cloth apron, dark trousers and practical brown ankle boots.
Composition/framing: vertical 1024 by 1536 canvas, entire standing figure and both hands visible, head in upper fifth with generous transparent margin above, narrow balanced silhouette within central 65 percent, feet fully inside canvas. Three-quarter front view, readable face at small display size.
Lighting/mood: soft even illumination, careful calm attention
Constraints: exactly one person, empty hands, transparent alpha around the entire silhouette. No other people, tools, bottles, water, charcoal, papers, test tubes, glasses, furniture, laboratory, floor, background, writing, symbols or watermark. Appearance and clothing are art direction only; do not invent a name, personal history or identity linking this inspector to a client.
files.prompt_ja: 日本語ファンタジーADV用の透過全身人物画。繊細なインク線、水彩の重なりと不透明な塗りの柔らかな陰影による抑制した物語画。温かな肌色と細やかな布のしわ。水質と設備を調べる匿名の検査人。空いた片手を小さく開いて説明する仕草をし、もう片手は腰の近くで自然に休め、注意深く立つ。後ろへ流した短い暗い栗色の髪、落ち着いた観察眼のある顔の中年の成人。くすんだ石板青色の長袖で膝丈の作業上衣、生成りの襟の詰まったシャツ、簡素な薄灰色の布前掛け、暗色のズボン、実用的な茶色の足首丈の靴。1024×1536の縦長画面に全身と両手を収め、頭を上部5分の1へ置き、上に透過余白を確保する。中央65％以内にまとまる輪郭、足先まで入る斜め前向きの構図。縮小時も顔が読み取れる。柔らかく均等な光、落ち着いて慎重な様子。背景と輪郭の周囲を完全透過にする。人物は一人、手には物を持たせない。他の人物、道具、瓶、水、炭、紙、試験管、眼鏡、家具、検査室、床、背景、文字、記号、透かしを入れない。外見と衣装は美術設定であり、氏名、経歴、依頼人との同一性を創作しない。
